hero.tagline: Find opponents. Set stakes. Prove your skill.
hero.sub: The competitive gaming platform where every match matters. Stake real money, climb the ranks, and become a legend.
home.featured_games_sub: Choose your battlefield. Dominate your opponents.
home.how_sub: Three steps to glory. No complexity. Pure competition.
home.step1_desc: Sign up in seconds. Link your gaming profiles. Verify your identity to unlock staked matches and withdrawals.
home.step2_desc: Choose your game, set your stake, and our matchmaking algorithm pairs you with an opponent of equal skill.
home.step3_desc: Play the match, submit your results. Winners get paid instantly. Climb the leaderboard and earn your reputation.
home.match_types_sub: Multiple ways to compete. Choose your arena.
home.duels_desc: Head-to-head competition with real money on the line. Set your own stake from €1 to €1000. Winner takes all.
home.tournaments_desc: Bracket-style competitions with entry fees and massive prize pools. Single elimination, double elimination, or round robin.
home.ladders_desc: Free competitive play. Earn XP, climb divisions from Bronze to Champion. Prove your worth without risking a cent.
home.freeplay_desc: Casual matches with no stakes. Perfect for warming up, practicing new strategies, or just having fun with the community.
home.fair_play_sub: Certified, transparent, and compliant with Swiss and EU regulations.
home.proof_desc: Both players must upload a screenshot or video proof of the match result within 30 minutes. No proof, no payout.
home.review_desc: Proofs are verified by AI within minutes. Disputed results are escalated to human reviewers and resolved within 24 hours.
home.verified_desc: Link your Steam, Discord, or gaming platform account. One account per player. Multi-accounting results in a permanent ban and forfeiture of funds.
home.regulated_desc: DuelStake is a skill-based competition platform, not a gambling service. Fully compliant with Swiss Federal Gaming Act (BGS) and EU regulations. Funds held in escrow by a licensed Swiss financial intermediary.
home.payout_note: How payouts work: Stakes are held in escrow during the match. After both players submit proof, the AI verifies the result. If both proofs agree, the winner receives the payout instantly (minus platform fee). If there's a dispute, a human reviewer decides within 24 hours. All transactions are logged and auditable.
home.testimonials_sub: Real players. Real wins. Real competition.
home.cta_sub: Join 50,000+ competitive gamers. Your first 3 matches are free.
